question.text: What is the minimum price movement (tick size) for Nifty/index option contracts traded on NSE?

explanation.text: The Logic: The tick size for index option contracts on NSE is Rs. 0.05 (5 paisa). This means option premiums can only change in multiples of 5 paisa. The Trap: The tick size for the option premium may differ from the tick size used for the underlying index or for futures contracts. Note: Tick size affects the smallest possible change in premium per unit; the smallest change in contract value works out to tick size x lot size.
